name: Tong Its
description: Tong Its is a popular Rummy-style game from the Philippines for three players. It involves drawing, melding sets/runs, and discarding. Players aim to empty their hands ('Tong Its') or minimize points. It features a mechanism to 'Draw' (fight) where players compare scores to end the hand early.

history.origins: Tong-its gained popularity in the 1990s in Luzon, the largest island of the Philippines. Its precise origin remains undocumented, but it is widely believed to have been introduced or influenced by US military presence in the 1940s and adapted from the American card game Tonk (1930s). The game was evolved and popularized among Ilocanos as Tong-its and spread to regions such as Pangasinan by the mid-1980s, where it is also known as Tung-it. Both the name and structure suggest a direct relationship to Tonk; Tong-its is effectively an extended version played with 12-card hands.
timeline: Late 20th century: Tong-Its appeared in the northern Philippines, extended version of Tonk with 12-card hands.
history.cultural: A favorite pastime in the Philippines.
history.evolution: Derived from Tonk and Mahjong mechanics.

rules.objective: Empty hand (Tong Its) or have lowest points when Draw is called/deck runs out.
rules.gameplay: 1. Draw (from Stock or Discard if meldable). 2. Meld (Bahay) optional. 3. Sapaw (Lay off) on others' melds. 4. Discard. Winning: 'Tong Its' (0 cards). 'Draw' (Call comparison). Stack run out.
keyRules: Cannot call Draw if Sapawed recently

strategy.basic: Meld early to avoid burning. Dump high cards.
strategy.intermediate: Hold cards to Sapaw opponents (preventing them from calling Draw). Call Draw when you have low points and opponents are likely heavy.
strategy.advanced: Card counting. Bluffing strength by not melding.

variations.name: Extra chips for long runs
variations.description: Some play with more special hands that earn extra chips, e.g. 3 chips for any 5-card or longer run that the winner has.

variations.description: Some play with a payment of only 2 chips instead of 3 for secret sets of 4, Tongit, and winning a challenge after a Draw.

scoring.description: Winner gets paid by losers based on points or fixed stake. Burned (Sunog) if no meld laid.
